title: Portal to the Loom of the Untraveled Road, Replica
flavorText: The true Portal to the Loom of the Untraveled Road remains elusive to the average adventurer, but you saw it yourself. Remind yourself that which so few remember by placing this replica in your home.
name: Portal to the Loom of the Untraveled Road, Replica

title: Fable of the Dragon
flavorText: A beautiful replica of the Fable of the Dragon, taken from the shelves of the Scholarium beneath Eyevea.
name: Fable of the Dragon

title: Skingrad Banner, Small
flavorText: Share your love of Skingrad, home to high-quality wines and cheeses, by hanging this small banner within your home.
name: Skingrad Banner, Small

title: Recollection Camp Sign, Sprouted
flavorText: Even the signs of the Recollection burst with life. Thankfully this one won't do more than provide a colorful bit of greenery to your home.
name: Recollection Camp Sign, Sprouted

title: Lucent Throne, Replica
flavorText: "Ah, this throne pokes at my curiosity. A replica, certainly. Yet the original comes from obscurity. Perhaps you'll discover its provenance?"—Gathareth of Skingrad
name: Lucent Throne, Replica

title: Colovian Lamppost, Overgrown
flavorText: The sturdy Colovian design of this post seems to have defeated the plant's attempts at crushing it … for now.
name: Colovian Lamppost, Overgrown

title: Colovian Cheese Press, Large
flavorText: Cheese presses are a common enough sight in Colovian homes. This large one allows artisans to press wheels large enough for feasts!
name: Colovian Cheese Press, Large

title: Ayleid Stele, Tall
flavorText: The intricate designs of this Ayleid stele provide an insight into the importance they placed on beauty and grace in their architecture.
name: Ayleid Stele, Tall

title: Fable of the Netch
flavorText: A beautiful replica of the Fable of the Netch, taken from the shelves of the Scholarium beneath Eyevea.
name: Fable of the Netch

title: Sapling, Dawnwood Growth
flavorText: The greenery of the Dawnwood may grow quickly, but it still goes through all the normal phases of plant life, as evidenced by this sapling.
name: Sapling, Dawnwood Growth

title: Table, Visions of the Five Companions
flavorText: The unique design of this large table allowed the Five Companions to plan, debate, and share information before setting out on their next adventure. Perhaps some memories of past days linger, waiting for you to watch?
name: Table, Visions of the Five Companions

title: Scholarium Column, Large
flavorText: Constellations mark even the columns of the Scholarium, adding visual interest to what would otherwise be a mere structural support component.
name: Scholarium Column, Large

title: Null Arca, Replica
flavorText: This replica of the Null Arca may not actually contain and stabilize the Arcane Knot, but it adds a sense of wonder to your living space.
name: Null Arca, Replica

title: Scholarium Door, Dragon
flavorText: A statue of the Luminary Dragon perches over this Scholarium door as if watching the proceedings in the room.
name: Scholarium Door, Dragon

title: Scholarium Door, Gryphon
flavorText: The imperious glare of the Luminary Gryphon makes the creature seem almost lifelike.
name: Scholarium Door, Gryphon

title: Scholarium Door, Indrik
flavorText: The splendid Luminary Indrik statue strikes a proud pose over this Scholarium door.
name: Scholarium Door, Indrik

title: Mirror of Truth, Replica
flavorText: The cracks in this ornate mirror remind many of something they can't quite recollect. And you dare not tell them.
name: Mirror of Truth, Replica

setBonuses.description:
(1 item) While actively Bracing, you gain Steam Guardian for |cffffff0.5|r seconds, reducing your damage taken by 90%. This effect activates only upon the start of Bracing and can occur once every |cffffff10|r seconds.

Blocking any attack while Steam Guardian is active reduces its cooldown by |cffffff5|r seconds, up to once per application of the effect.

traitDescription: Reduces the cost of Block by 4%.

title: The Shadow Queen's Cowl
enchantDescription: Adds 868 Maximum Stamina.
flavorText: You are beautiful. Shadowed, beautiful, and hidden. They cannot see you, darkness clings like a lover. They will not remember you, gray upon their mind. She breathed you into being. Be the deeper darkness. - Romien Garvette
name: The Shadow Queen's Cowl

setBonuses.description:
(1 item) While crouched, you can see Witnesses and Guards through walls.

Successfully pickpocketing a Witness or Guard applies Distracted to them for |cffffff10|r seconds, stunning them and decreasing their Stealth detection radius by 30 meters for the duration.

traitDescription: Reduces the cost of Roll Dodge and Sprint by 6%.

title: The Saint and the Seducer
enchantDescription: Reduce Health, Magicka, and Stamina cost of abilities by |cffffff133|r. This effect does not work with abilities that drain their cost multiple times over their activation.
flavorText: Twin visages stare out at you from this medallion. One implacable and determined. One sly and smirking. Which calls to you?
name: The Saint and the Seducer

setBonuses.description:
(1 item) While in combat, you gain one of five random Major buffs which changes every |cffffff10|r seconds. Enemies within 12 meters of you gain one of five random Minor debuffs depending on which buff you have. The available effects are:

Major Berserk and Minor Maim
Major Resolve and Minor Breach
Major Force and Minor Brittle
Major Evasion and Minor Vulnerability
Major Courage and Minor Cowardice

traitDescription: Increases movement speed by |cffffff7|r%.
